definitions.short: a look ; hence (figuratively) striking appearance , revelation , or (by implication) compact
definitions.full: H2380. chazuth חָזוּת noun feminine vision, conspicuousness (on formation compare Lg BN 202 ) — absolute ׳ח Isa 21:2 ; Dan 8:5 , 8 ; construct חָזוּת Isa 29:11 ; suffix חָזוּתְכֶם 28:18 ; — 1 vision, oracle of a prophet הֻגַּדלִֿי קָשָׁה חָזוּת Isa 21:2 a hard vision is declared to me ; הֶחָתוּם הַסֵּפֶר כְּדִבְרֵי הַּכֹּל חָזוּת לָכֶם וַתְּהִי 29:11 the vision (prophecy) of the whole is become to you as the words of a sealed writing ; תָקוּם לאֹ אֶתשְֿׁאוֺל חָזוּתְכֶם 28:18 your agreement with Sheol will not stand , so Thes MV De Che Di and others after Vrss, but Ew § 156 e renders oracle , and Siegf. Hellseherei , see חֹזֶה 2. 2. conspicuousness in appearance: הָזוּת קֶרֶן a conspicuous horn Dan 8:5 +? 8:8 ; 8:21 ; so אַרְבַּע חָזוּת 8:8 , but < read אֲחֵרוֺת others , as ᵐ5 Gr Bev.
